summary: CheerPlanner v2.2 batch — Feature #5 (Calendar Month/Week/Day toggle) and Feature #6b (Fundraiser goal_amount + public progress bar + copy-link) — ALL PASS. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases green (goal_amount create/patch/get, public endpoint returns goal_amount, no-goal null case, calendar day/week/month range slicing + multi-day 'day N/total' expansion + out-of-range exclusion). Frontend (390x844): Calendar tab shows Month/Week/Day segmented toggle (testIDs calview-month/week/day); Week view renders 'Week of Sun, 06-28-2026' with cal-prev/cal-next arrows advancing by 7 days ('Week of Sun, 07-05-2026' after next) and events grouped under each of 7 day headings; Day view renders single-day list with cal-prev/cal-next stepping by 1 day; Month view keeps existing react-native-calendars grid, colored dots, legend, and selected-day event list. Fundraisers form shows 'Goal (optional, USD)' input (testID fundraiser-goal-input); saving with goal=1000 + amount=400 persists, and re-opening in edit mode preloads value '1000'. Public share page /f/<token> (no auth) renders progress bar with '40% of $1,000.00 goal' text and Copy link button (testID copy-link-btn); no-goal fundraiser correctly hides the progress bar and percentage while still showing Copy link.
critical_code_review_comments: calendar.tsx: isoStartOfWeek uses local timezone Date(iso+'T00:00:00'); in edge timezones this could produce off-by-one week starts. Currently works for tested env; non-blocking.

f/[token].tsx: on web, copyLink() uses navigator.clipboard which requires a secure context and user gesture; if it fails silently the 'Link copied!' confirmation won't appear. Consider a fallback using document.execCommand or explicit try/catch messaging. Non-blocking (still uses Share on native).

fundraisers.py POST: for a fresh Fundraiser without an explicit goal_amount the model default of None is stored; PATCH does not allow clearing goal_amount back to None (goal_amount not in nullable_fields set) — if intentional this is fine, otherwise add 'goal_amount' to nullable_fields to let users remove a goal.
seed_data_creation: All test fundraisers and schedule events created by pytest are cleaned up via teardown_class. Two UI-created fundraisers (TEST_UI_goal_fund, TEST_UI_nogoal) were deleted via API after UI verification. No orphaned data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.2 features #5 (calendar toggle) and #6b (fundraiser goal + copy link) verified end-to-end. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_v22_goal_and_calview.py (9 tests, JUnit XML in pytest_v22_goal_calview.xml). UI verified with mobile viewport 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Public /f/<token> render + progress bar + Copy link button work without auth. Note: LogBox 'Uncaught Error 401' overlay pops up on Expo web at the login screen because of an early /api/auth/me probe; harmless — dismissible via 'Minimize' button and does not affect UX after login. #7 custom event types was deferred per instructions and NOT tested.
